show_projections: create a matplotlib plot of 2D keypoint projections with optional skeleton sticks and bounding box overlay
visdom_plot_pointclouds: build a Visdom scatter plot of multiple 3D point clouds with optional skeleton sticks and color legend
matplot_plot_point_cloud: create a 3D matplotlib scatter plot of a point cloud with optional skeleton sticks and custom view angle
extend_to_3d_skeleton_simple: build a 3D skeleton point cloud by interpolating line segments between keypoint joints
fig2data: create a numpy array from a matplotlib figure by rendering it to a PNG buffer
